title_zh: 约定按实际幅度描述销售趋势

scenario.label_zh: 约定按实际幅度描述销售趋势
scenario.goal_zh: 核对每周销售图的变化，并约定区分先前平稳期与近期的小幅下降

context_zh: 同事检查一张虚构商店销售图，避免把轻微变化夸大为崩跌。
author: author-phase09-b

sentences.speaker: Asha
sentences.text: I've described April sales as a collapse. Does that sound too strong?

sentences.speaker: Bram
sentences.text: Much too strong. The line shows a slight fall in the final week, not a collapse.

sentences.speaker: Asha
sentences.text: What about the first three weeks? The figures aren't exactly identical.

sentences.speaker: Bram
sentences.text: They're close enough to call sales steady during that period. Look at March: sales rose steadily every week then.

sentences.speaker: Asha
sentences.text: So April ended somewhat below where it began, after three fairly stable weeks.

sentences.speaker: Bram
sentences.text: Exactly. Keep March separate so readers don't think the upward trend continued all through April.

sentences.speaker: Asha
sentences.text: I'll replace 'collapse' with that more precise description and label the two months clearly.
